sentences.text: Shidaisaurus was a medium-sized, predatory theropod dinosaur that closely resembled its relatives.
Its skull features a paroccipital process that faces downward and to the sides, a trait shared with other allosauroids.
The second cervical vertebra possesses a tall, sharply pointing epipophysis, a bony projection on the spine.
In this animal, the length of the pubis bone equals the height of the iliac blade.
Many of its dorsal vertebrae lack pleurocoels, air-filled cavities often found in later dinosaurs, a feature attributed to its primitive nature.
Shidaisaurus holds the distinction of being the oldest known allosauroid to date.
A 2016 estimation listed the creature as being 7.1 meters long and weighing 950 kilograms.
The genus Shidaisaurus was formally described in 2009 by Wu and colleagues.
Fossils were unearthed from Middle Jurassic rocks of the Lufeng Formation in Yunnan, China.
Shidaisaurus is classified as a metriacanthosaurid dinosaur.
It belongs to the family Metriacanthosauridae.
The species is further classified within the subfamily Metriacanthosaurinae.
This dinosaur lived during the Middle Jurassic, approximately 174 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
The estimated time range for Shidaisaurus spans between 170.9 and 168.2 million years ago.
